construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by Gurobi (gurobi_write, MPS), then its one-line "OBJSENSE MAX" rewritten as the two-line form "OBJSENSE" / "    MAX" (MOSEK 11.2 rejects the one-line form with error 1100 at the next line); read back by gurobi_read and by MOSEK (mosekopt read), both equal to the definition. Gurobi model.Q = Q/2 (Gurobi's objective is x'Qx); the QUADOBJ section holds the upper triangle of Q (objective 1/2 x'Qx).
derivation: Maximise -1/2 (x1^2 + x2^2) - x1 subject to x1 + x2 = 2, x >= 0 (Q = -I, c = (-1, 0); the objective is strictly concave, so the optimum is unique). Substituting x2 = 2 - x1: -1/2 x1^2 - 1/2 (2 - x1)^2 - x1, derivative -2 x1 + 1 = 0, so x1 = 1/2, x2 = 3/2 (bounds inactive); objective -1/2 (1/4 + 9/4) - 1/2 = -7/4.
